svg.title: Evaluations and measurements
svg.desc: Sub-millisecond recorded snapshots, 70/70 project workflow runs, and reclaimed idle-tab memory. Every headline below links to its method and retained samples. Historical latency and agent-task runs were recorded October 13, 2026; memory runs October 21. Runtime release measurements below are dated October 23. Each result applies to its recorded build and workload.
